src/cache-service.ts.name: Saved events
src/cache-service.ts.description: Lets napplets read and write a host-supplied local copy of Nostr events.

src/coordinated-relay.ts.name: Relays plus saved copy
src/coordinated-relay.ts.description: Answers subscriptions from both the saved copy and live relays, removing duplicates and signalling once when both have caught up.

src/count-service.ts.name: Event counts
src/count-service.ts.description: Counts Nostr events matching a filter through a host backend, on relays chosen and approved before the count runs.

src/relay-pool-service.ts.name: Relay pool service
src/relay-pool-service.ts.description: Passes napplet subscribe, publish and close requests to the host's relay pool, honouring an explicit relay when one is named.
